notes.title: Let's play CtrlC
notes.notes:
CtrlC Stream during [b]Steam Next Fest[/b]

This is going to be my second live stream on Steam. I'm looking forward to playing CtrlC with you and answer to all your questions. Let me know what you want to know about my game or let me know your feedback in the chat!

This time with challenge mode turned on - [b]one wall hit = reset![/b]
